notes.title: Fixed Multiplayer Issue
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Some players experienced a bug with the multiplayer not working in certain regions - we were able to track the cause and have amended the build.

Thank you!

notes.title: We're a Finalist in the 2024 Australian Game Developer Awards!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044680/f48028efd6b8f1c62c6b950933e26c9b0350a31d.png[/img]

It's time for an E-Goop party. [i]NEON Squad Tactics[/i] is a finalist at the 2024 AGDAs, to be held in our home town of Melbourne during International Games Week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044680/f235a7573302e4a8f5356d19ea211052deba54a3.png[/img]

It's an absolute honour to be included alongside many other amazing Australian-made games. You can check out the full list of all the finalists [url=https://agdas.com.au/2024-finalists/]here[/url].

We'll be launching the PC version of [i]NEON Squad Tactics[/i] on September 18th, and will be demoing the game and selling merchandise during PAX Australia in October!

notes.title: NEON Squad Theme Tune Trailer
notes.notes:
NEON Squad Tactics has just released on the Meta Quest Store, so we are finally able to post our new release trailer that includes our incredible new theme tune, composed and sung by Monster Mansion!

[previewyoutube=5L84RWJAI0c;full][/previewyoutube]

We're currently developing a PCVR version of NEON Squad Tactics, which will see a release on Steam in a few months time. If you love turn-based tactics games and love VR, then we would love it if you could wishlist and spread the neon love.

We'll be posting more about the game right here over the weeks leading up to launch. Keep on gooping!

WISHLIST NOW!
